note: v621: [[god]] command panel (?cards=1) redesign and Send fix. Send never fails silently: it checks the card is still open (stale card says so and swaps to the open job), shows sending/sent/received or a red error with the reason, and waits for the intake receipt. Picks survive the 30 s poll (selection kept in JS; unchanged card is not re-rendered); taps use pointerup+click deduped. Each option shows the real tweet line under its code label. Story text in self-hosted Literata (18 KB subset). Panel height capped with the card body scrolling inside so the drag header stays grabbable; dragged position re-clamped on resize/growth. CAP_DEFAULT stays 10.
